_note: The credits and licences screen (scenes/ui/credits.tscn, scripts/ui/credits.gd; checklist item GC-08 in sops/09-game-release-checklist.md), opened from the main menu, and the main menu's copyright lines. THIRD_PARTY.md at the repo root lists the same components (LP-03). An entry with "engine": true takes its licence text from the engine at run time (Engine.get_license_text), and the screen also lists the third-party parts inside the engine with their licence texts (Engine.get_copyright_info, Engine.get_license_info), so none of that is copied here. Every "text" is a verbatim licence text: Dialogue Manager's is project/addons/dialogue_manager/LICENSE (tests/test_credits.gd checks that they match); the CPML is https://huggingface.co/coqui/XTTS-v2/raw/main/LICENSE.txt as fetched on 2026-10-27.
